none: PAS NLM-E9CB32: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine
contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine (306-361), probably an irregular copy of a fallen horseman issue, 355-361, Reece period 18. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right, large eye. Reverse description: Soldier advancing left spearing fallen horseman. Reverse inscription: [FEL TEMP REPARATIO]. Diameter: 10.3mm, Weight: 0.63gms, die axis: 6
